text: This app is great 🌈. It enforces social accountability via collective challenges ☺️🙏 It could become a sucessor of Habitica's social features 👏👏👏 I also love the UI, it's so readable and visual 📱✨. Could you please enable creating public challenges (not only via invite)? Or could you please add more challenges to join, like Reading Club (read every day + check-in on Sunday + review at the end + vote for next book) 🥰 You guys are great, thanks for this app! 🌈 (Give it a distinctive name!)
author: Cristi Rivero
developer_reply:
Hey Cristal,
Your feedback made our day! We're so happy you love Habithook and its social features. Public challenges are on our radar, and your idea for a Reading Club challenge sounds awesome! We’ll explore adding more community-driven challenges soon.

Thanks for your support—it truly means a lot!
— The Habithook Team
